recipes.name: Double Tomato Bruschetta with Balsamic Reduction
ingredients: 1 tsp oil from jar of sun-dried tomatoes
1 Tbsp oil from jar of sun-dried tomatoes
instructions: In a bowl, combine the chopped tomatoes, basil, sun-dried tomatoes and oil, capers, garlic, onion powder, salt, and pepper. Set aside to allow the flavours to meld.

Make the balsamic reduction by pouring the vinegar in a saucepan*. Cook uncovered at a gentle boil until the volume reduces to about a quarter or third of the original volume, about 8 minutes. Stir often.
Brush both sides of the bread with the sun-dried tomato oil and toast on a frying pan over high heat, or in the oven on broil until the edges are golden.
Serve the bruschetta with the toasted bread, drizzle over a very small amount of the balsamic reduction, and enjoy!

page_recipe_notes: Notes † 1 - 2 Tbsp is also sufficient if you don't want to make a reduction. * If short on time, mix 1 - 2 Tbsp (5 - 10 mL) balsamic vinegar in the bruschetta instead of making the reduction.
Storage The bruschetta will keep in an airtight container in the fridge for up to 3 days. The balsamic reduction can be kept at room temperature for up to 1 week.
